summary: Iteration 9 (Next.js 15 App Router migration + Autopilot Requeue + Comments delete-confirm) tested end-to-end. All 12 backend pytest cases pass and all 11 Playwright UI flows pass. SSR verified via raw curl (Googlebot-visible H1) for /, /blog, and /blog/<slug>. Autopilot Requeue endpoint returns correct 200/400/404 semantics; UI shows red-tinted failed rows with an ap-requeue-<id> button that flips the item back to 'queued'. Comments delete confirmation dialog opens, Cancel dismisses, Confirm deletes via DELETE /api/admin/comments/{id}. AdminGuard client-side redirect from /admin → /admin/login when unauthenticated works. NOTE: the review request references slug 'aussie-super-back' which does NOT exist in seeded data — I used the real slug 'working-holiday-visa-super-refund-guide' (as the request itself later suggests for SSR verification).
action_items: Cosmetic: review_request mentions slug 'aussie-super-back' but no such post exists; either seed it or update the review checklist to use one of the real slugs (e.g. working-holiday-visa-super-refund-guide, how-to-claim-australian-super-refund-2026-guide).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 1295 lines — approaching size where splitting into routers (admin, blog, leads, autopilot) will help maintainability.
AutopilotItemCreate accepts null category but frontend sends '' from empty input; currently coerced fine but consider trimming server-side.

AdminGuard is purely client-side — the initial HTML for /admin/*, /admin/blog, /admin/comments is still delivered to unauthenticated visitors before the JS redirect. For a lead-magnet marketing site this is acceptable but a Next.js middleware.ts would be a stronger guard.
Comments delete dialog: 'disabled while in-flight' works for both Confirm and Cancel buttons — good. Consider also disabling the row's Delete button to avoid double-open.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted MongoDB doc into autopilot_queue with id='TEST_FAIL_ITEM_9', status='failed' to verify UI red-tint + requeue button. Cleaned up after test. Backend pytest also creates its own queue items and cleans them via /admin/autopilot/queue DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://aussie-super-back.preview.emergentagent.com. Supervisor runs next dev (not CRA). Admin login works. All 6 seeded blog posts render via SSR — verify with `curl -s <url>/blog/<slug> | grep '<h1'`. Autopilot Requeue endpoint: POST /api/admin/autopilot/queue/{id}/requeue → 200 on failed, 400 on queued, 404 on missing. Comments AlertDialog uses data-testids: delete-confirm-dialog, delete-confirm, delete-cancel; row delete triggers are data-testid=delete-<commentId>. If you need to force an autopilot item to failed, use pymongo update on collection autopilot_queue.
